captions.detailed: A cylindrical bedside air purifier featuring a white slotted outer housing, a grey pleated inner filter cylinder, and a dark grey twist-off top cap. The lower half of the main body is designed with vertical slats for air intake, revealing the interior filter. The dark grey top cap rotates along the vertical axis via a twist-lock joint, and the inner filter cylinder is designed to slide prismatically upward out of the main housing.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a cylindrical bedside air purifier. It must include a white outer housing with vertical air intake slots on the bottom half, a dark grey twist-off top cap that rotates around the vertical axis, and an inner grey filter cylinder that can slide vertically out of the housing.
captions.factory: The code constructs three main parts: the housing, the filter, and the cap. The housing is created by extruding concentric circles to form a hollow cylinder, then using polar arrays of subtracted boxes to cut vertical intake slots. The inner filter is modeled as a smaller concentric cylinder with pleated fins. The top cap is built as a shallow, dark ring that fits over the housing. The assembly defines two joints: a continuous revolute joint for the top cap rotating on the vertical axis, and a prismatic joint allowing the filter to slide vertically.
